Lore of Morninghollow

A first guide to the setting, drawn from the universe’s existing public premise.

Ayen

The current public synopsis describes Ayen as a formless consciousness from the void, drawn toward light and given form in service of God’s glory.

Vry’s technology

Vry’s advanced technology enables an interface that lets humanity engage with a fourth-dimensional layer in a form people can understand.

The defenders

Through that interface, people can command powerful battle armor and take part in the struggle to defend creation.

The conflict

The setting’s central conflict is a war against rising darkness. The details of its factions, history, and chronology will be expanded here as the canon is transferred.
